versions.changelog:
- Added suite metadata and suite URL to clarify inclusion in the Overpowered skill suite.
- Updated description and heading to reference the Overpowered suite.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file for simplification.

Initial release of the "find-the-exceptions" skill.

- Provides a structured procedure to identify material exceptions in rules or processes before automation.
- Outlines exception lenses (e.g., boundaries, timing, authority, dependency failure) to systematically uncover non-happy-path cases.
- Defines an output contract for documenting conditions, paths, statuses, and evidence needed.
- Includes interaction guidance: ask one high-value question at a time and recommend defaults when possible.
- Emphasizes distinction between material exceptions and irrelevant hypotheticals.
- Ensures processes are only considered executable once all significant exceptions are resolved or owned.
